dashboard.title: Genvora — AI Audit Pipeline
dashboard.description: 7-panel overview of the Genvora Temporal audit pipeline: scan volume, scores, latency, bot vs browser, errors, recommendations, and crawlability blockers.

panels.title: Scan Volume
panels.description: Number of audit scans initiated per 5-minute window

clickhouse.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime64(start_time / 1000000000, 3), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS ts, count() AS scan_count FROM signoz_traces.distributed_span_list WHERE service_name = 'genvora-worker' AND operation_name = 'activity.fetch_page' AND start_time >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime64(start_time / 1000000000, 3), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS ts, count() AS scan_count FROM signoz_traces.distributed_span_list WHERE service_name = 'genvora-worker' AND operation_name = 'activity.fetch_page' AND start_time >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Score Trends
panels.description: Average, min, and max AI readiness score over time

clickhouse.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime64(start_time / 1000000000, 3), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS ts, avg(toFloat64OrZero(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'score.overall')])) AS avg_score, min(toFloat64OrZero(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'score.overall')])) AS min_score, max(toFloat64OrZero(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'score.overall')])) AS max_score FROM signoz_traces.distributed_span_list WHERE service_name = 'genvora-worker' AND operation_name = 'activity.score' AND start_time >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime64(start_time / 1000000000, 3), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS ts, avg(toFloat64OrZero(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'score.overall')])) AS avg_score, min(toFloat64OrZero(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'score.overall')])) AS min_score, max(toFloat64OrZero(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'score.overall')])) AS max_score FROM signoz_traces.distributed_span_list WHERE service_name = 'genvora-worker' AND operation_name = 'activity.score' AND start_time >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Activity Latency Breakdown
panels.description: p50 / p95 / p99 duration (ms) for each audit activity

clickhouse.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime64(start_time / 1000000000, 3), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS ts, operation_name, quantile(0.5)(duration / 1000000) AS p50_ms, quantile(0.95)(duration / 1000000) AS p95_ms, quantile(0.99)(duration / 1000000) AS p99_ms FROM signoz_traces.distributed_span_list WHERE service_name = 'genvora-worker' AND operation_name LIKE 'activity.%' AND start_time >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY ts, operation_name ORDER BY ts, operation_name

SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime64(start_time / 1000000000, 3), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS ts, operation_name, quantile(0.5)(duration / 1000000) AS p50_ms, quantile(0.95)(duration / 1000000) AS p95_ms, quantile(0.99)(duration / 1000000) AS p99_ms FROM signoz_traces.distributed_span_list WHERE service_name = 'genvora-worker' AND operation_name LIKE 'activity.%' AND start_time >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY ts, operation_name ORDER BY ts, operation_name

panels.title: GPTBot vs Browser Latency
panels.description: Average fetch_page duration by user agent — AI bots vs standard browsers

clickhouse.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime64(start_time / 1000000000, 3), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS ts, tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'user_agent.selected')] AS user_agent, avg(duration / 1000000) AS avg_latency_ms, count() AS fetch_count FROM signoz_traces.distributed_span_list WHERE service_name = 'genvora-worker' AND operation_name = 'activity.fetch_page' AND start_time >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY ts, user_agent ORDER BY ts

SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime64(start_time / 1000000000, 3), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS ts, tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'user_agent.selected')] AS user_agent, avg(duration / 1000000) AS avg_latency_ms, count() AS fetch_count FROM signoz_traces.distributed_span_list WHERE service_name = 'genvora-worker' AND operation_name = 'activity.fetch_page' AND start_time >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY ts, user_agent ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Error Rate
panels.description: Number of spans with ERROR status over time — failures across all activities

clickhouse.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime64(start_time / 1000000000, 3), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS ts, operation_name, countIf(status_code = 'ERROR') AS error_count, count() AS total_count, round(countIf(status_code = 'ERROR') * 100.0 / greatest(count(), 1), 1) AS error_rate_pct FROM signoz_traces.distributed_span_list WHERE service_name = 'genvora-worker' AND operation_name LIKE 'activity.%' AND start_time >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY ts, operation_name ORDER BY ts, error_count DESC

SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime64(start_time / 1000000000, 3), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS ts, operation_name, countIf(status_code = 'ERROR') AS error_count, count() AS total_count, round(countIf(status_code = 'ERROR') * 100.0 / greatest(count(), 1), 1) AS error_rate_pct FROM signoz_traces.distributed_span_list WHERE service_name = 'genvora-worker' AND operation_name LIKE 'activity.%' AND start_time >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY ts, operation_name ORDER BY ts, error_count DESC

panels.title: Recommendation Severity
panels.description: Distribution of recommendation severities — critical / warning / info counts

clickhouse.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime64(start_time / 1000000000, 3), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS ts, sum(toInt32OrZero(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'recommendations.critical')])) AS critical, sum(toInt32OrZero(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'recommendations.warning')])) AS warning, sum(toInt32OrZero(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'recommendations.info')])) AS info FROM signoz_traces.distributed_span_list WHERE service_name = 'genvora-worker' AND operation_name = 'activity.generate_recommendations' AND start_time >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime64(start_time / 1000000000, 3), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS ts, sum(toInt32OrZero(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'recommendations.critical')])) AS critical, sum(toInt32OrZero(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'recommendations.warning')])) AS warning, sum(toInt32OrZero(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'recommendations.info')])) AS info FROM signoz_traces.distributed_span_list WHERE service_name = 'genvora-worker' AND operation_name = 'activity.generate_recommendations' AND start_time >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Crawlability Blockers
panels.description: Count of scans with each crawlability issue — robots.txt blocks, missing llms.txt, JS rendering required

clickhouse.query: SELECT countIf(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'robots_txt.allows_ai')] = '0') AS ai_bots_blocked, countIf(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'llms_txt.present')] = '0') AS missing_llms_txt, countIf(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'js_rendering.required')] = '1') AS requires_js_rendering, count() AS total_scans, round(countIf(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'robots_txt.allows_ai')] = '0') * 100.0 / greatest(count(), 1), 1) AS blocked_pct FROM signoz_traces.distributed_span_list WHERE service_name = 'genvora-worker' AND operation_name = 'activity.check_crawlability' AND start_time >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)

SELECT countIf(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'robots_txt.allows_ai')] = '0') AS ai_bots_blocked, countIf(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'llms_txt.present')] = '0') AS missing_llms_txt, countIf(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'js_rendering.required')] = '1') AS requires_js_rendering, count() AS total_scans, round(countIf(tag_string_values[indexOf(tag_string_keys, 'robots_txt.allows_ai')] = '0') * 100.0 / greatest(count(), 1), 1) AS blocked_pct FROM signoz_traces.distributed_span_list WHERE service_name = 'genvora-worker' AND operation_name = 'activity.check_crawlability' AND start_time >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
